name: What should I do if I have a burst pipe?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I have a burst pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have a burst pipe, the first critical step is to immediately locate and turn off your main water supply to prevent further water damage. Once the water is off, contact Alpha-Plumbing Services right away. Avoid attempting to fix a burst pipe yourself, as this can often lead to further complications. Our emergency team will respond quickly to address the issue professionally and minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Immediately turn off your main water supply, then contact Alpha-Plumbing Services for professional assistance. Do not attempt to fix it yourself.
